name: @pokemap/cli
comment: No "bin" entry: node packages/cli/src/index.ts fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the @pokemap/core/src/*.js deep import (Node 24's type stripping does not rewrite .js -> .ts specifiers, and core ships no exports map). Only `tsx` can run this file today, so `bin` comes back once there is a build step producing real .js. Until then, use `npm run pokemap` below.
